notes.title: Loot Hunter update 118 released!
notes.notes:
Hi! Here is a new update of the game! News in the version 1.18: 

 "New level" reward raises with the level number
 Treasures gives more gold now (depends on the player level)
 BATTLE: gold bonus increased
 BATTLE: cannon bonus increased
 BATTLE: skill Double Damage costs only 3 action points now (was 5)
 BATTLE: power of Deadly skills is increased by +1
 Fixes bug "Bring me X items"
 A few small gameplay improvements and bug fixes
 Suppor 4K resolution!

notes.title: Loot Hunter update 115 released!
notes.notes:
Hi! We have prepared another bigger update of the game. Here is the list of changes and new features in the new build 115st: 


 you can see how many items in inventory you need for quests (red number next to the amount)
 there are more opponents near the player's level
 added one simple quest type
 fixed crash in inventory
 fixed bug with the duplicating items in a quest "bring something to somewhere"
 fixed repeated attacking of eneny ships
 skill "maneuver" has a lower chance to change any stone to a cannonball stone
 fixed journal - now you can jump to other pages
 A few of minor bugs fixed

notes.title: Loot Hunter update 110 released!
notes.notes:
Hi! We have prepared a major update of the game after the feedback we have received from players in the last few days. Here is the list of changes and new features in the new build 110st:


Adjusted collisions with land. The ship should sail more easily.
The camera view was adjusted, so the ships are closer and bigger.
The shops offer five items for sale.
A golden number on an item in a shop indicates an item with a favorable price.
Rare items have higher prices.
Price of a peace with a faction depends on how many ships of that faction you have sunk.
Shop is accessible in locations with a quest.
Autosave after each battle and finished quest.
Ships you buy have different number of slots for upgrades.
Items show, whether they are common, rare or unique.
You can end a battle immediately by a surrender button in the game menu.
You can see multiple enemy ships while in a battle with a squadron.
High level ships are more expensive.
A lot of bugs fixed
